import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

[docs]
def vis(top_curve, bottom_curve, curves, ax=None, show_median=True, band_alpha=0.5, color='skyblue'):
    if ax is None:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    # Plot the functional band depth
    ax.fill_between(np.arange(bottom_curve.shape[0]), bottom_curve, top_curve, color=color, alpha=band_alpha)

    if show_median:
        # Plot the median curve
        median_curve = np.median(curves, axis=0)
        ax.plot(median_curve, color='red', label='Median Curve', linewidth=2)

    ax.set_xlabel('X-axis')
    ax.set_ylabel('Y-axis')
    ax.set_title('Functional Band Depth Plot')
    ax.legend()

    return ax
